verdict.rationale: Retrieval-latency targets or measured numbers are a fair thing to ask of a knowledge/retrieval product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack states latency targets, p50/p95 figures, or any benchmark. The docs cover scopes, permissions, page graphs and Studio, but not retrieval performance.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented retrieval-latency targets or measured numbers (e.g. p50/p95) backing the product's speed claims
